About us

A family business that knows the work inside out

Based in Minster, Thanet. Over nine years in commercial ventilation, fire protection and facilities work. We show up, we do it properly, and we document everything.

Built on years of real site experience

Clear Flo Extracts is a small family business from Minster in Thanet. We've been doing this work for over nine years — not as a sideline, but as the main job, day in and day out.

Before Clear Flo, the background was eight years working on ventilation and facilities at some of the biggest commercial sites in London — Canary Wharf, London Bridge City — handling permit-to-work, out-of-hours access, and the documentation standards that come with large contracts. That experience is built into the way we work on every job, big or small.

We grew up around construction and building work — it's in the family. That means we understand structures, access, and how to work in live environments without causing disruption. It also means we're honest about what a job involves and what it costs, before we start.

Rooftop plant room work — this is what a lot of commercial ventilation servicing actually looks like

What we do

Extract cleaning is at the core of what we do — but it’s not all we do. Here’s the full picture.

🏺

TR19® Kitchen Extract Cleaning

Full grease extract cleaning to TR19 standard — canopy, ductwork, fan and all accessible components. Full photographic compliance report and certificate every time.

🔥

Fire Damper Inspection & Servicing

BS 9999 compliant fire damper inspection, operational testing and written reports. Planned maintenance contracts available. Full asset register produced.

⚙

Fan & Ventilation Unit Servicing

Extract fans, AHUs and ventilation units cleaned, inspected and serviced. We’ll flag anything that needs attention before it becomes a bigger problem.

📌

Ductwork & Spiral Duct Cleaning

Rectangular, circular and spiral ductwork cleaned using rod and brush systems. We access from both ends and photograph throughout to prove the clean.

📄

Compliance Reporting & Certification

Every job produces a full photographic compliance report. We use our own digital reporting tools, built in-house, to produce clean, professional documentation on site.

🏢

Service Contracts & Planned Maintenance

Annual and 6-monthly contracts for both kitchen extract cleaning and fire damper servicing. We schedule, remind and report — you just keep the records.

How we work

What you can expect from us

We show up on time

Evening and overnight slots available. We work around your operation — your kitchen stays open, your compliance gets done.

We photograph everything

Before, during and after. Every job is documented in full — the kind of evidence your fire safety file and insurance actually need.

We don’t do unnecessary cleans

We come back to inspect and advise on cleaning frequency. If it doesn’t need doing yet, we’ll tell you — not charge you for a clean it didn’t need.

We know the standards

BESA GHT/GHO qualified, NAADUK accredited, TR19 certified. We understand what the standards actually require and how to meet them properly.

Qualifications & accreditations

🏅

BESA GHT/GHO Qualified

British Engineering Services Association — the trade body qualification for grease hygiene technicians and operators.

✅

NAADUK Accredited

National Air Duct Cleaners Association accredited — recognised industry standard for ductwork and ventilation hygiene.

📄

TR19® Certified

All kitchen extract cleaning completed to TR19 Grease standard. Full certificate and photographic compliance report issued every visit.

🔥

BS 9999 Compliant

Fire damper inspections carried out to BS 9999 — written report and pass/fail record for every damper tested.

🔒

Permit to Work

Experienced with hot work, confined space and high-level access permit-to-work procedures. We understand what large sites require.

🛡

Fully Insured

Public liability insurance in place. All work documented with photographic evidence. Ready for any compliance audit.

Where we work

We’re based in Minster, Thanet — right on the Kent coast. Most of our regular contracts are across Kent and in London, but we’re not limited to those areas. If you’re in the South East and need the work done properly, we’re happy to travel.

We’ve worked on major London sites at Canary Wharf and London Bridge City, so distance and large sites are no obstacle. For one-off jobs and new contracts, just get in touch and we’ll let you know if we can get to you.
